correctness.rationale: Exact one-step (C,B) transitions pc/n, qc/n and 1-c/n imply the displayed differential generating function with P_1=u; direct substitution plus the unique coefficient recurrence establishes the all-n law, including r=1-qv=0 by limit. With Z=B-(q/p)(C-1), each selected retained birth subtracts q/p and deleted birth adds one, so conditional variance is qC/(pn), telescoping to q(a_n-1)/p^2. Predictable root-parent events sample independent Bernoulli p edge marks: the (k-1)st retained success has NB(k-1,p) failure count. Yule embedding C(t) rate p, N(t) rate 1 yields almost surely positive W=C_n/n^p; independent marks yield B_n/C_n->q/p. Martingale predictable quadratic variation/n^p->qW/p^2 and bounded jumps give stable Gaussian mixture and self-normalized N(0,q/p^2) for fixed 0<p<1. Independently computed rational Markov moments through n=8; finite calculation only corroborates infinite proof.

value.rationale: The first-generation number of components attached to the retained root cluster is a natural branch-degree observable of the contracted percolation tree, distinct from cluster size or total descendant mass. Its exact joint law, stopped negative-binomial distribution, finite centered variance and intrinsic-size CLT reveal a reproducible structural fluctuation phenomenon; a researcher on genealogical trees could use precisely these formulas.

limitations: Only fixed 0<p<1 and uniform recursive attachment with independently marked edges; variable p_n and nonuniform growth outside scope.
Stable martingale CLT is a standard theorem with bounded jumps and random predictable variance, not a formal machine certificate.
